blocks.heading: Every app in the phi world
blocks.subtitle: Apps are records like everything else
blocks.body: Phiapp is the directory of the ecosystem: every app, the pages and menus it is made of, the kinds it speaks and the agents behind it on PhiADK. All of it read live from Phiora — edit a menu record and the app wears it on its next load.

blocks.title: The apps
blocks.sub: Each one the same shared shell — only its records differ.

blocks.title: The agents behind them
blocks.sub: Every app has its agent on PhiADK; phient runs them.

apps.title: Apps
apps.sub: Every app in the database — composed back from app, menu, page and block records.

pages.title: Pages
pages.sub: Every page of every app, as records. A page's blocks are records too.

menus.title: Menus
menus.sub: The rails and sub-navs of every app. Edit one record, the app changes.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.sub: The shared ontology every app speaks: one items table, props on the record, relations as reference props.

agents.title: Agents
agents.sub: The agents of the ecosystem on PhiADK — phient serves them, apps call them.

blocks.title: How they run
blocks.body: The platform is PhiADK; phient is its agent runtime — what ollama is to models, phient is to agents. phient lists them, serves them over one small API and runs their verbs; Phiora stays the one place data and money move.
